rca of the issue: Original user symptom (wait message with no progress) was targeted via new readiness/upload-recovery checks. Verified that failed upload now surfaces explicit failed badge + retry, retry reuses same upload_id and skips already-acknowledged chunk0, and play intent is bounded/cancellable with manual relaunch after timeout.
